text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Are these materials essential as well? 
What a dilemma. 
I was hoping to avoid adding another 
briefcase, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right in the midst of preparations for the 
Holy Hoof Festival, Symboli Rudolf 
was busy packing a massive stack of 
documents into cases.
choice_data_list: Sorting through documents? Looks tough.
Sorting through documents? Looks tough.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm? No... I am merely preparing to tackle 
this mountain of pending matters in one 
fell swoop.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I intend to confront them earnestly in a 
distant, 
unfamiliar environment far removed from 
our usual routine.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Would you care to join me? 
It should serve as a pleasant breath of 
fresh air for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later—for reasons beyond me, 
we found ourselves at a tourist 
destination.
choice_data_list: Y-You're going to work here?
Y-You're going to work here?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I find work progresses far more 
smoothly in places like this. 
—Now then, let us begin.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Please, feel free to spend your time as 
you wish. 
I hear there is a windmill down this path. 
It is said to offer quite a charming view.
choice_data_list: S-Sure. Got it...
Y-Yeah. Got it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still bewildered, I set off to do some 
sightseeing. 
...Can she really get any work done in a 
place like this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After taking a stroll through the flower 
fields, 
I returned to Symboli Rudolf's side.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, welcome back. 
Perfect timing. I have just cleared 
through one major hurdle myself.
choice_data_list: Wait, really?! That's incredible...!
Wait, really?! That's incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh. 
Now then, shall we change locations?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Next is the running order for the outdoor 
stage presentations. 
...This will be a formidable puzzle.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Accommodating everyone's requested time 
slots 
while preventing congestion along 
backstage traffic lines...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...—! Hmm, I see it now. 
We shall proceed with this order.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then, where is the production 
schedule...
choice_data_list: Is this it?
Is this it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that is the one. 
Thank you, you have my gratitude.
choice_data_list:
If it's small things like this, I'm happy 
to help.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Hello. Yes, I looked over it moments ago. 
Please proceed under this policy. 
Furthermore, regarding the paint order...
choice_data_list: Here, the purchase order.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Much appreciated.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, apologies. I would like to place an 
additional order for red. 
The haunted house's bloodstains require...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clack-clack-clack-clack... Clack!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Good, that settles this for now. 
We will submit this document in this 
format.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then. 
—I believe that was the last of what I 
brought along.
choice_data_list: A-Amazing. You really finished it all...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh... My brain has grown a bit 
overheated. 
There is a lounge nearby. Let us cool down 
there.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Phew... 
Blue skies beyond the clouds. It truly 
feels as refreshing as the idiom suggests.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You did well to keep me company through it 
all. 
I imagine it must have been tedious for 
you.
choice_data_list:
Not at all... Do you always work at 
tourist spots?

Not at all... Do you always work at 
tourist spots?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, of course not. 
Normally, I am a tourist through and 
through.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Though it may not look it, travel is a 
hobby of mine. 
...Yet one day, I realized something.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
An unfamiliar land, an unaccustomed 
environment... 
In such places, one naturally stays on 
edge. And then—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
One's senses sharpen, and thoughts become 
crystal clear. 
...And so, I thought to try working in 
such a state.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ever since, I have made it a habit to 
regularly rearrange 
my room to recreate a similar atmosphere, 
but...
choice_data_list:
There's a limit to that, so you came to a 
tourist spot this time.

There's a limit to that, so you came to a 
tourist spot this time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...However, that my work progressed 
so remarkably today 
is also credit to your devoted support.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to express my gratitude once 
more. 
...Thank you for coming along with me.
choice_data_list: I'm just glad I could be of help!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. ...Now then. Thanks to that, 
we still have plenty of time before we 
must head home.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
From here on, this is a genuine trip. 
What would you like to do, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
In that case, I'd like to check out the 
souvenir shop.

I'd like to tour some of the sightseeing 
spots.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that sounds splendid. 
I shall pick out some gifts for Air Groove 
and the others as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Oho... The souvenir shop's lineup 
has taken on a distinct autumn charm.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm. A washi paper lampshade... A fine 
design. 
Autumn-exclusive... It makes me want to 
incorporate it into my room.
choice_data_list:
You did mention rearranging your room 
often.

You did mention rearranging your room 
often.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. This autumn, I shall make 
this lampshade 
the centerpiece of my interior decor.
choice_data_list:
Then let me buy it for you as a thank-you 
for today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There is no need for thanks. 
If anything, I am the one who dragged you 
along.
choice_data_list:
I got to see so many things unexpectedly, 
so it's my treat.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Is that so? 
If you insist that much, then I shall 
gratefully accept.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. 
Once it is in place, I will be sure to 
send you a photograph.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That sounds wonderful. Then let us go gaze 
upon 
the breathtaking scenic splendor of this 
land.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It is entirely different from the 
surroundings of Tracen Academy. 
Looking down from high up makes that all 
the clearer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, my. Take a look. 
There is a photo cutout standee over 
there.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It is designed for two people, no less. 
We must take a picture together, wouldn't 
you say?
choice_data_list:
What?! You actually take pictures in 
those?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, of course. 
This is the true quintessential thrill of 
travel.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Come along now. 
A traveler casts shame to the wind, 
Trainer.
